, Reason for Mistake: In the calculation step, the Assistant incorrectly counted only 3 paying visitors per visit and excluded the 2-year-old, even though only infants under 1 are free. This undercounted the daily-ticket total and led to the wrong savings figure. The Assistant also relied on an unverified $8.25 ticket price from a search snippet rather than confirming current prices on the museum’s site, further compounding the error.
